title: A whole-body cell type atlas mapped into an electron microscopy volume of an annelid worm
authors: Phillip OA; Cyril Christophe Daniel Robert C; Leslie P; Elena B; Samuel HP; Luca S; Tobias G; Nikolaos P; Martinez VH; David P; Vanessa D; Lara N; Yanina BP; Victoria W; Asli BK; Idoia QU; Maria AJ; Jacob M; Anna K; Detlev A
one_liner_zh: 该文构建环节动物全细胞图谱并整合单细胞转录组与电镜体积，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Differential gene expression establishes the distinct physiology and morphology of cell types in an animal body. Single-cell sequencing and volume EM represent milestones toward the characterization of cell types, yet are difficult to combine for a comprehensive view on the cellular genotype-phenotype link. Here, we map a whole-body single-cell transcriptome into the PlatyBrowser, a multimodal cellular atlas for the marine annelid Platynereis dumerilii , and establish this combination uniquely for an entire animal. We learn that, in the 6-days-old worm, the majority of genes are tightly co-regulated to jointly implement one of eight major cellular morphotypes representing epidermis, gut, vasculature, myofibres, glia, motile cilia, glands, or neurons. Focusing on neurons, we uncover 14 families that by transcription factor identity, axonal projection, or sensory-secretory apparatus resemble conserved neuron types found in vertebrates, insects, or nematodes. We hypothesize that these existed in urbilaterian ancestors and represent the ancient core of nervous system centralization.
abstract_zh: 差异基因表达确立了动物体内细胞类型的独特生理和形态。单细胞测序和体积电子显微镜是表征细胞类型的重要里程碑，但难以结合以全面观察细胞基因型-表型关联。在此，我们将全身体单细胞转录组映射到PlatyBrowser中，这是一个针对海洋环节动物海蠕虫（*Platynereis dumerilii*）的多模态细胞图谱，并首次为整个动物建立了这种组合。我们发现，在6天大的蠕虫中，大多数基因紧密协同调控，共同实现八种主要细胞形态类型之一，分别代表表皮、肠道、血管系统、肌纤维、胶质细胞、运动纤毛、腺体或神经元。聚焦于神经元，我们揭示了14个家族，这些家族通过转录因子身份、轴突投射或感觉-分泌装置，与脊椎动物、昆虫或线虫中发现的保守神经元类型相似。我们假设这些神经元类型存在于两侧对称动物祖先中，并代表了神经系统中枢化的古老核心。
